simple.meaning: טֹהַר (ṭôhar) is a Hebrew word meaning “literally brightness ; ceremonially purification.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H2892. tohar טֹּ֫הַר noun [masculine] purity, purifying — 1 purity , לָטֹּ֫הַר הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּעֶצֶם Exod 24:10 (JE), as the body of heavens for purity. 2 suffix טָהֳרָהּ יְמֵי Lev 12:4 , 6 the days of her purifying (menstruation). [ טֳהָר ] (see Ges § 10 . 2. B), or [ טְהָר ] (Ol § 173 b Bö § 386 ), noun [masculine] clearness, lustre (dubious word; below טֹהַר Hup Pe SS; so Thes, reading מִטָּהֳרוֺ ) — only מִטֳּהָרוֺ הִשְׁבַּתָּ Psa 89:45 ; De Hup Pe Sch thou hast made (him) to cease from his lustre ; ᵑ9 ᵑ6 made his lustre to cease , so AE Ki and others reading noun מִטְהָרוֺ or מִטְּהָרוֺ (dagesh forte according to Ges § 20 . 2. 2 b), and Schr SK 1868, 642 who reads טְהָרוֺ הִשְׁבַּתָּה ; Gr proposes עטרתוֺ his crown ; Bae מִיָּדוֺ מַטֶּה sceptre from his hand.
